The test failure on aarch64-Linux is due to missing configuration for nixos features in the runner. It can be fixed by adding a github actions environment variable named EXTRA_NIX_CONFIG

With value `system-features = nixos-test benchmark big-parallel kvm uid-range`

Goupile is Linux only for now.
I believe the errors on aarch64-linux is because the runners don't support KVM, so they can be ignored.

@Prince213 they must support kvm see my above comment on how to enable it, the tests worked on aarch64 Linux https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/470416#issuecomment-4081836015

I'm not sure why it's working if it's not supported. And why it's not discovered by nix if it is supported.

So this line can be removed.
